title: Pharmacy closures and on-call strike activity, separate from public procession
reason: Closures/strike activity are not public gathering attendance. Local reporting distinguishes pharmacy strike/closures from the approximately 570-person march; no separate public gathering count is assigned to closures.

eligibility.summary: Article mentions pharmacies on strike/closed, but does not describe that work stoppage itself as a separate public assembly.

participants_min.summary: No participant count for the work stoppage as a gathering; cannot use store closures or worker totals as event attendance.
